verdict.rationale: AI explanations and fix suggestions for failed commands are a fair axis for a terminal emulator; some terminals ship this, so the story applies. Nothing in the pack shows Alacritty offering any AI assistance or failure analysis. Its documented features are vi mode, search, regex hints, multi-window, configuration and IPC, and the README stresses a minimal scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI explanations and suggested fixes when a command fails
